basic_details.job_title: NIT Andhra Pradesh Recruitment 2026 - Walkin for Ad hoc Faculty Posts
basic_details.organization_name: National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Andhra Pradesh (NIT Andhra Pradesh) has officially announced the Ad-hoc Faculty Recruitment 2026 with 2 openings. The detailed notification was published on the official website, https://nitandhra.ac.in. Candidates holding the prescribed qualifications, including First Class B.Tech./ B.E., M.Tech./ M.E., MBA, M.Com., or equivalent qualifications in the relevant discipline (Ph.D. desirable), are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 05 August 2026. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for age limit and other eligibility details.

qualification.education_qualification: First Class B.Tech. and MBA (Full time), First Class Bachelor's Degree with M.Com. and MBA (Full time), First Class B.Tech./ B.E. and M.Tech./ M.E. in ECE or allied branches, Ph.D. in relevant discipline (desirable)
qualification.details: School of Humanities and Management (Management): First Class in B.Tech. M.Com not mandatory with Ph.D. Electronics and Communication Engineering: First Class in both B.Tech./B.E. and M.Tech./M.E. or equivalent in respective branch of Engineering or allied branches. Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline desirable.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Andhra Pradesh Ad-hoc Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled for 05 August 2026 for Humanities and Management and 07 August 2026 for Electronics and Communication Engineering. Candidates should attend on their respective dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Ad-hoc Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include First Class B.Tech. and MBA (Full time), or First Class Bachelor's Degree with M.Com. and MBA (Full time), or First Class B.Tech./B.E. and M.Tech./M.E. in ECE or allied branches. A Ph.D. in a relevant discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Ad-hoc Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 55000 to Rs. 70000 per month. Candidates with a Ph.D. will receive Rs. 70000 per month, while those with M.Tech. or equivalent will receive Rs. 55000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NIT Andhra Pradesh Ad-hoc Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Ad-hoc Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Offline Lecture Demonstration, an Offline Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the NIT Andhra Pradesh located?
faq.answer: NIT Andhra Pradesh is located in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 534101.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates if applicable, category certificate if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a specific age limit for the Ad-hoc Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any age-related details.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these Ad-hoc Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The job type is contractual, meaning the positions are offered on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q10. How can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article by clicking on the provided link for the Official Notification PDF.
